scope: Deterministic selected-context and CCR-recovery baseline for the Phase 3 envelope contract.

source_decisions.claim: Context packing records raw/packed token metrics, preserves required facts, and fails closed when a required fact cannot be supplied.
CCR storage restores a known chunk exactly and represents a missing chunk as a failed lookup.

assertions: packing exposes raw/packed token metrics and non-negative measured token savings
a missing mandatory fact produces an inconclusive insufficient-budget outcome
CCR restores a known chunk byte-for-byte and rejects a missing chunk

limitations: This gate does not attest the P3 public ToolResult envelope, selected evidence identifiers, omission reasons, or recovery-handle schema.
P3-T01 and P3-T02 must add direct red/green contract evidence before enabling those behaviors.
